name: Loot Run
hook: Clear the floor, grab the shiny loot, go deeper.
how: Fight through every room of a dungeon floor with your party. Monsters drop gear in five rarities, kills level the whole party up, and when the floor is clear the stairs open to a harder one. If everyone goes down, the run ends.
controls: WASD to move, aim with the mouse, click or Space to swing, E to spin; on touch, a thumb stick, ATTACK and SPIN
uses: Your deepest floor and your total runs and kills are saved for next time.
The deepest floor each player reached.
The host's browser runs the monsters, the loot drops and who picked up what; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
AI heroes fill the party until enough people join.
Everyone sees the same dungeon, monsters, swings and loot as they happen.
Run a loot event (more drops) without touching the code.
ideas: Add a mage class that throws fireballs
